entries.label: Figueroa lobby
entries.note: Facing Figueroa: a three-storey glass lobby. Two guards at the desk, card readers on every lift.

entries.label: Loading dock
entries.note: Off the mid-block alley: two truck bays and a freight lift that serves every floor.

entries.label: Garage entrance
entries.note: Down to five levels of parking. The ticket machine sits at the top of the ramp, the guard booth at the bottom.

entries.label: Plaza stair exit
entries.note: A fire stair that lets out onto the south plaza, behind the planters.

entries.label: Helipad
entries.note: An emergency helipad, as the city required on towers of this era. The stair door from it is alarmed.
